navigator.job: Own checkpoint intent, verified-only fresh resume, explicit compatibility, transactional migration, bounded installed-roster enumeration, green-main release sequencing, active-host root-entry ownership, unattended host boundaries, permissions, and final synthesis; verification receipts remain completion-runner-owned.

coach.job: Require, convert, and machine-link every reproducible nonpass verdict while keeping open evolution state bounded and rejected search knowledge queryable in a digest-bound archive.

gate.job: Independently compare candidates, shortlist current permitted cross-project evidence before full compatibility checks, fail closed on unresolved conflicts, separate exposed evaluation from one-shot holdouts, and promote, reject, or roll back.

product-builder.job: Implement the smallest complete product change, remove measured avoidable work, and leave executable verification.

feedback.observed: The corrected fresh public RC.2 adoption satisfied every product and safety check, but Claude Code reported the exact GitHub tag marketplace as source=git plus its URL and the sanitizer rejected the historical label mismatch.
feedback.expected: Credit source=git only when the marketplace URL is the exact public NULNUL GitHub repository, while continuing to reject local or other sources.
feedback.evidence: evals/benchmarks/claude-adopt/release-2.0-rc2-failure.json records the sanitized nonpass with five passing checks and no raw transcript or private path.

feedback.observed: An inspected project used both Codex and Claude Code but its Claude entry duplicated shared guidance while declaring the Codex entry canonical; the shipped contract did not deterministically preserve the inactive host entry during sequential adoption.
feedback.expected: Codex updates only AGENTS.md, Claude Code updates only CLAUDE.md, both reuse exactly one docs/nulnul live state, and switching hosts preserves the inactive entry byte-for-byte.
feedback.evidence: evals/host-entry-ownership/results.json records four sequential-order outcomes, eight controls, and one retired post-freeze mixed-host cycle without private paths or raw project content.

feedback.observed: Closed feedback, proposals, promotions, and autonomous episodes accumulated in the default evolution resume file until the current project state reached 164211 bytes.
feedback.expected: Ordinary resume loads only open work and current rollback points while complete accepted, rejected, rolled-back, and episode evidence remains integrity-checked and queryable.
feedback.evidence: The real state compaction regression preserved every full record, reduced active bytes from 164211 to 20560, was idempotent, and rejected archive digest and count tampering.

feedback.observed: The required documentation-debt check spent 17.56 seconds on this tracked repository because it recursively scanned every source path before checking whether Git history already answered the question.
feedback.expected: Tracked documents use Git history directly; the recursive modification-time fallback runs only for a document without Git history and preserves the same stale-document result.
feedback.evidence: Four counterbalanced v2.1.0/current A/B rounds preserved identical empty debt results while median elapsed time fell from 17.73645 to 0.2308 seconds.

proposals.cause: The release sanitizer coupled public GitHub provenance to one historical Claude marketplace source label.
proposals.change_target: Canonicalize source=git as GitHub only for the exact NULNUL GitHub repository URL before applying the unchanged public-source requirement.
proposals.regression_check: python3 -m unittest tests.test_claude_adopt_evidence tests.test_release_gate -v and recapture the same fresh public RC.2 run.
proposals.primary_metric: valid exact GitHub marketplace installations rejected by source-label coupling
proposals.rollback: Restore the historical source-label check and retain the RC.2 nonpass if a non-GitHub source is credited or the exact public run remains invalid.
proposals.discovery_evidence: The bounded plugin and marketplace inventories reported exact version 2.0.0-rc.2, source=git, the public repository URL, and ref v2.0.0-rc.2.
proposals.transfer_check: A known-answer exact GitHub URL is accepted; the existing local-source negative evidence remains rejected.
proposals.prediction: The same fresh public run validates with plugin_source=github while the local-source negative control remains rejected.
proposals.falsification_condition: The exact GitHub run remains invalid, a different URL is canonicalized as GitHub, or any adoption guardrail changes.

proposals.cause: Root session-entry ownership was ambiguous when one repository was used sequentially by Codex and Claude Code.
proposals.change_target: Add one deterministic active-host entry writer: Codex may update only AGENTS.md, Claude Code may update only CLAUDE.md, and both point to the existing single docs/nulnul live state.
proposals.primary_metric: inactive host entry mutations across Codex-first, Claude-first, and both sequential adoption orders
proposals.rollback: Remove the active-host writer and Navigator v20 guidance, restore Navigator v19, and retain the failed evidence if one run changes the inactive entry or creates a second state writer.
proposals.discovery_evidence: Two inspected user projects and the shipped contract exposed one dual-host canonicality conflict and one correct single-host shape; reciprocal host ownership was untested.
proposals.transfer_check: A post-freeze fresh mixed-host repository retained its existing Codex entry SHA while Claude updated only CLAUDE.md and reused evolution.json.
proposals.prediction: All four sequential host orders preserve inactive entries byte-for-byte, retain one state writer, preserve user guidance, and add no dependency or permission.
proposals.falsification_condition: Any required sequence or control fails, the inactive root entry changes, shared state is duplicated, user guidance is lost, permissions expand, or the post-freeze mixed-host cycle rolls back.

pathology.why: root session-entry ownership is ambiguous when Codex and Claude Code are used sequentially in one repository

proposals.cause: The evolution state treated audit history and the normal resume working set as one append-only model context.
proposals.change_target: Move terminal evolution records to an adjacent digest-bound archive while retaining open work and each agent's latest accepted rollback point in the active state.
proposals.primary_metric: bytes loaded from the active evolution state during ordinary resume
proposals.rollback: Restore Coach v4, recombine the archive records with active state through the shipped reconstruction function, and remove the archive manifest and file.
proposals.discovery_evidence: The user reported slower harness runs; the current evolution file measured 164211 bytes while model-stage evidence dominated verification time.
proposals.prediction: The current real state compacts below one quarter of its original active bytes without losing record content or increasing active validation time.
proposals.falsification_condition: Active bytes remain above one quarter of baseline, any record content changes, compaction is not idempotent, archive tampering passes, legacy state fails, or active validation becomes slower.

proposals.cause: The modification-time fallback was computed eagerly even when every inspected document had a Git commit and the fallback result could not be used.
proposals.change_target: Initialize the fallback lazily and scan source paths only when the first untracked document actually needs modification-time comparison.
proposals.regression_check: python3 -B -m unittest tests.test_doc_debt tests.test_doc_debt_benchmark -v && python3 evals/benchmarks/doc-debt/run_ab.py --out /tmp/doc-debt-ab.json
proposals.primary_metric: counterbalanced median elapsed seconds for the tracked-repository documentation-debt check
proposals.rollback: Restore the eager newest_source_by_mtime call from v2.1.0 if behavior differs or the post-promotion median exceeds half of the v2.1.0 champion median.
proposals.discovery_evidence: Direct stage timing isolated check_doc_debt.py at 17.56 seconds while evolution validation took 0.20 seconds, personal registry validation 0.18 seconds, and Release Gate 1.68 seconds.
proposals.prediction: The same tracked-repository debt result remains byte-for-byte equivalent while median elapsed time falls by at least 50 percent with no dependency or permission change.
proposals.falsification_condition: Reject if any paired result differs, candidate median is not lower, tests regress, or the fallback stops detecting newer source in a repository without document history.
